points.description: Lists at least four distinct, correct objectives of IPv6 drawn from the model answer: support billions of end-systems (larger address space); reduce routing tables; simplified header / simpler processing; increased security; real-time traffic / QoS (flow label, traffic class); multicasting; mobility (roaming); open to future change (extension headers); coexistence with existing protocols.
points.partial_credit: Two or three correct objectives earn 0.25 (a vague or half-stated set of four also earns 0.25).

points.description: Objectives are stated specifically enough to be the item asked for (e.g. 'quality of service for real-time traffic', 'simplified header', 'reduce routing table size'), not just generic claims such as 'better' or 'faster'. Four objectives must be given, each with its key term.
points.partial_credit: Only some of the objectives are specific, or only two or three are given with their key terms: 0.25.

rubric.notes: Full marks need four distinct correct IPv6 objectives from the model answer, each stated specifically. Two or three correct objectives, or four stated vaguely, earn about half. Wrong or generic items (e.g. 'faster internet') do not count toward the four; no valid objectives earns 0.
